engines.configuration: Clang 23 Release core; GCC 15 standalone worker; no temporary diagnostic patches in the timed engines

measurement.scope: From first source request through every 256-line page, including IPC, UTF-8 encoding and hashing. Startup, open, function listing, assembly listing, Qt painting and scrolling are excluded.
limits: Three alternating pairs per entry, with varying host load; these samples do not establish statistical significance.
Median changes compare the two medians, not the median of per-pair speedups.
Four unchanged source hashes establish reproducibility only, not semantic equivalence to the machine code.
The 0x38ef0 output changes because recovered control-flow coverage changes; it is not equal-output throughput.
Separate single-flight and combined runs are not a controlled guard-only ablation.
No GDB duration, temporary-instrumented stage/depth duration, or IR-dump duration is included in the normal timing arrays.

regression_309d0.status: Observed latency and CPU regression; internal cost source remains unresolved.

sdk_prepare.scope: SDK prepare only; excludes worker listing, IPC, C rendering and GUI; process CPU includes all process threads.

limits: The comparison is of the exact public C API text exports, not a deep equality of every internal LowFunc/MedFunc/HighFunc field.
Callee MayWrite/EntryRead summary maps are not rendered by these APIs. Extra callee LocalRegisterEffect data is transient in computeCallRegisterEffects.
Identical final views do not prove identical intermediate pass work or allocation costs.
A separate compilation was running. Neither SDK phase-log durations nor process elapsed time from this run are production performance evidence.
All-stop breakpoints change scheduling and single-flight/cache behavior; timings are not performance data.

Counts only measure entries into full CFG construction and x87/no-return request boundaries. They do not count resolver stages, evidence queries, intermediate pass work, allocations or completed proof outcomes.
Repeated entries may have different construction contexts; this counter does not establish that repeats can safely share a graph.
The candidate contains both single-flight and expanded guard-query limits; any observed change is not assigned to one feature without another isolated comparison.

regression_309d0.interpretation: No changed final public IR export or expanded callee build target set was observed. This does not prove equal intermediate queries, proof stages, allocations, summaries or pass costs.

limits: This is an isolated diagnostic proof-bound experiment, not a production performance benchmark.
64 stage evidence and64 depth evidence are separate probes;128 captures both simultaneously. Engine hashes and source snapshots are preserved.
Only two GuardAlias resolver-depth arguments changed. Work budgets and existing syntax/materialization depth limits were unchanged.
No GDB call-stack samples were collected. The result proves the64-depth barrier drives this oscillation, but does not distinguish transparent CFG traversal from genuine expression nesting.
The result does not establish128 as a universally sufficient or appropriate production limit.

ida_comparison_limits.paired_run_scope: str(ida_hexrays.decompile(entry)) after separately timed database open and automatic analysis; one fresh database per entry.
notes: No IDA speedup ratio is asserted: timing boundaries, automatic-analysis work and EH ownership differ.
The prior debugger research found debugger-gated verification work. Its GDB timings are not used here.
The 860-byte root tail contains exception cleanup and _Unwind_Resume; this observation is not an overall semantic-correctness ranking.
These observations do not establish that NeverD has surpassed IDA.

guard_red_green.cache_regression_scope: 80-step predecessor fixture succeeds only with expanded depth; 160-step fixture remains incomplete; an expanded result cannot satisfy a later default-depth request

full_affected_suites.scope: Affected Release native suites, not all repository profiles or GUI painting.

merged_source_smoke.scope: One fresh worker request per entry; integration/output verification only, not a new speedup estimate.
